footer_note: Interactive rendering of the canonical v3 diagram in docs/architecture.md (same folder) — the Mermaid source there is the source of truth, and this rendering is generated from the same model. The Error Reporter and Error Reports store are PROPOSED (kit error-reporting standard, Phase 1) and are shaded grey in the source; they are not part of Version 1.
header_sub: Drag any box to move it, drag the background to pan, scroll / pinch buttons to zoom, click a box for its details. Dragging explores the view — it does not change the canonical source (docs/architecture.md in this repo). Version 1 (test stage); the two grey boxes are PROPOSED (the error-reporting standard) and are not in Version 1.

admin.body: Recognised by the Firestore admin registry at sign-in. Manages the global template, impersonation, and the danger zone.
admin.title: Super Admin (owner)

admins.body: system_admins — Super Admin seats, one doc per user ID, enabled flag only. Managed solely from the Firebase Console or the seed script.
admins.title: Admin Registry

audit.body: audit_logs — the append-only usage trail the app writes and the portal reads.
audit.title: Audit Logs

authsvc.body: Google provider sign-in. Popup-first in the app, with a redirect fallback.
authsvc.title: Firebase Auth

cache.body: The last-seen streak value, kept on the device for an instant first paint. Firestore is the source of truth and overwrites it on every snapshot.
cache.title: First-paint Streak Cache

deploy.body: On push to main: validates the page, injects the Firebase API key from the repo secret in place of the placeholder in index.html, and publishes to GitHub Pages. Companion checks: fleet CI, link check, Lighthouse.
deploy.title: Deploy and CI Workflows

errreports.body: PROPOSED, not in Version 1: error_reports — create-only from clients, no public reads. The Firestore sink of the proposed Error Reporter.
errreports.title: Error Reports (PROPOSED)

gconfig.body: global_config/system_defaults — the default-task template and the early check-off buffer. Read by provisioning, reset, and the portal.
gconfig.title: Global Config

members.body: families/default/members — one profile doc per signed-in user, under the single invisible default family.
members.title: Members

page.body: The entire app in one file: boot, auth, provisioning, realtime sync, task UI, streak engine, admin portal, and cross-cutting services — all running in the visitor's browser.
page.title: Web App (index.html)

repo.body: Canonical source: the single-file app, the spec, and this diagram. Public showroom repo; full history lives in a private archive repo.
repo.title: Routines & Streaks Repo

reporter.body: PROPOSED, not in Version 1: one funnel every failure passes through. Classifies by effect into tiers and hands a minimal report to a pluggable sink.
reporter.title: Error Reporter (PROPOSED)

seed.body: scripts/seed-admin.mjs — grants or revokes Super Admin seats in the registry. Owner-run; the app itself can never write the registry.
seed.title: Seed Admin Script

streaks.body: families/default/streaks — counters per user, plus one completion-proof doc per finished cycle so a cycle can never count twice.
streaks.title: Streaks and Completions

tasks.body: families/default/tasks — routine tasks, owner-scoped: the app queries by ownerId and stamps each task with its cycle.
tasks.title: Tasks

user.body: Signs in with Google and runs the daily routine: evening and morning tasks, check-offs, and the streak. Test stage: the owner and testers.
user.title: User

panel_body: One static file does everything: the page is served by GitHub Pages and runs in the visitor's browser, Firebase Auth signs users in, and Firestore holds every store as cylinders. The deploy workflow is a gear on GitHub Actions; the seed script is a gear on the owner's workstation. Click any box for its job.
